The Fantomon system unlocks at '''Lv. Character 50''', providing powerful allies that boost your overall Power.

Acquisition: Summon Fantomons at the Arborisfatum or exchange Summon Crystals for Mythic Fantomons. The [Arena Shop] also offers special Fantomon shards.

Upgrade & Resonance: Feed Fantomons with Treats to level them up. Only the 4 deployed Fantomons need to be leveled—the Resonance Level is set by the lowest level among them, and all other Fantomons automatically match it. Level them evenly to maximize overall Power.

Auto-Pick: Activates when a Fantomon is deployed. Automatically collects all items dropped during exploration.
